items.title: Pay 'Aktualisierungsgebühr' fee
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment rather than a period to be counted, so the due date is used exactly as written: 30 November 2026 (a Monday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed).

warnings: This letter shows strong hallmarks of a scam/phishing attempt: 'Zentralregister Fahrzeugdaten Deutschland' is not a real German vehicle-registration authority — registered-keeper data in Germany is held by the local Zulassungsstelle, not by any private central register that sends such 'update fee' demands.

The payment is requested to a Lithuanian IBAN (LT98 7044 0001 1820 4477) made out to a private individual (R. Kazlauskas), not to any public authority account — a German authority would never use a foreign private IBAN for fee collection.

The letter uses pressure/threat language ('Ohne Aktualisierung kann die Zulassung ab Januar 2027 ruhen' and 'melden wir den Vorgang der zuständigen Zulassungsstelle') typical of fake-invoice scams targeting vehicle owners; the user should not pay and should verify directly with their local Zulassungsstelle/KBA instead.

No Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung, no official reference to a real legal basis, and no verifiable contact (only a generic P.O. box and a plausible-looking but unverified phone number/email) are given, which is inconsistent with genuine German authority correspondence.
